Closing the Medicaid coverage gap will help us fight HIV/AIDS across Georgia.
 
We can better serve all of our communities when we give them access to coverage for treatment and care.
 
This cannot wait.
https://t.co/F3by3iEv6Z

My brother @SenOssoff & I secured new federal investments to help address the HIV/AIDS epidemic in the Metro ATL area. 
 
The resources will help Georgians with HIV/AIDS access the health care, treatment, and support services they need, plus more.https://t.co/g0ZVtdIO6S

Insulin isn’t optional for millions of people—it’s the difference between life and death, & rising costs can have patients struggling to pay for treatment or rationing medication.

Capping the cost of insulin is a priority, and I won’t let Washington forget it.

Excited to make sure the #FarmBill2023 works for Georgia’s farmers by:  
 
🍑Expanding export opportunities for GA's farmers
👩‍🌾Bolstering tools for beginning & underserved farmers
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦Protecting federal nutrition benefits
💻Strengthening rural communities; & more.

In 2017, I was arrested in the Russell Rotunda protesting nutrition program cuts to the Farm Bill.
 
Today at our @SenateAgDems Farm Bill hearing, I focused on uplifting the needs of Georgians struggling with food insecurity.
 
It’s good to be at the table.

In addition to protecting vital nutrition benefits, I’m focused on pushing policies in the 2023 Farm Bill that will help small farmers & the businesses around them thrive, and help  move our rural economies forward.

I’m a Matthew 25 Christian. 
 
As we reauthorize vital federal nutrition programs in the Farm Bill, we must center our policy conversations around our society’s vulnerable and marginalized.

The idea of children being hungry, in the wealthiest nation on the planet is unconscionable. 
 
As I work with my colleagues to write the 2023 Farm Bill, know that I'm laser-focused on making sure we fulfill our promise to protect vital nutrition benefits for our kids & families.

Every Georgian deserves quality health care coverage.
 
Proud to join @SenatorBaldwin in urging @HHSGov to protect patients from junk plans that don’t have to cover essentials like maternity care, prescription drugs, substance use disorder treatment & emergency room care.

At today's @SenateAgDems hearing, I made it plain: nobody should have to worry about being able to provide food for their family. 

Watch me discuss why the Senate needs to defend access to vital nutrition programs, especially for our children.
https://t.co/pF1otEUxia

All Georgians deserve equal treatment under our nation’s laws.

This is far overdue. #ERANow

As a preacher, I believe in the power of redemption. And as a public servant, I believe in getting good done. 
 
That is why I’m proud to join @SenBooker to push legislation to provide vital nutrition  benefits to returning citizens who have paid their debts to society.

If Washington Republicans have their way, we can either deal with the aftermath of defaulting on our debt for the 1st time ever, OR we can allow ~23,000 older Georgia adults to potentially lose vital nutrition benefits. 

That’s a false choice for hardworking Georgia families.

WATCH: While I believe that we must fund law enforcement, who are at the front lines of illegal drug trafficking, we must also fund treatment, recovery & diversion for substance use disorder if we want to mitigate the damage to our communities caused by opioids. https://t.co/usaPTtytmZ

I’ve been arrested for protesting cuts to vital nutrition programs in the Farm Bill because no kid should go hungry—and certainly not in the richest country in the world.

Now I’m keeping up the fight to protect these programs, as a Senator and member of @SenateAgDems.

In the wealthiest country in the world, no one should ever go hungry.

So as we work on the Farm Bill and to keep the government open, I’m pushing to protect vital nutrition benefits to ensure that no Georgian has to worry about how they’ll get their next meal.

I have long fought to ensure that all voters have a voice in their democracy, and I have some concerns & questions about how @CityofAtlanta is working to ensure eligible voters of Atlanta can exercise their right to participate in the political process. https://t.co/hdqqAZxDTv

Lunch at Augusta’s Café 209 is always a great idea. Glad to catch up with some Augusta-area clergy to talk about the importance of protecting access to vital nutrition benefits like SNAP. https://t.co/x6j6n7QLVE

I’m working every day to ensure the Farm Bill includes ways to improve precision technology used for farming.

Congress can do this, protect vital nutrition benefits & so much more if we have the will to do it.
https://t.co/jqIrbiEG4g
As a member of @SenateAgDems, I won’t let politicians in Washington use the Farm Bill to undermine vital nutrition benefits for hungry kids and families.

This ruling will harm Americans trying to exercise their fundamental rights. 

We must do all we can to defend the right to vote.

This is deeply concerning and needs to change—quickly.
I’m watching this situation closely and stand ready to do all I can at the federal level to protect nutrition benefits for Georgians. https://t.co/DYY48Dkcda

I was once arrested in the Russell Rotunda for protesting proposed SNAP cuts in the Farm Bill.

Now, as a member of @SenateAgDems, I’m helping to write the *next* Farm Bill—and you better believe I’m fighting to protect these vital nutrition benefits.

Some good news for Georgia SNAP users recovering from Hurricane Helene—now through Nov. 7 you can purchase hot foods with your SNAP benefits!

To find out if you are in one of the eligible counties, visit https://t.co/QHGLcGn2MB.

In February, @SenOssoff, @RepNikema & I urged @TheJusticeDept to prioritize an investigation of the Fulton County Jail, and the results of their investigation are disturbing & heartbreaking.

This inhumane and unconstitutional treatment must end now.
